moderation_reports_one_target.name: moderation_reports_one_target
moderation_reports_one_target.value: ("moderation_reports"."listing_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("moderation_reports"."reported_user_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

deals_accepted_at_valid.name: deals_accepted_at_valid
deals_accepted_at_valid.value: ("deals"."status" NOT IN ('accepted','completed') OR "deals"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("deals"."accepted_at" IS NULL OR "deals"."status" IN ('accepted','completed','cancelled'))

business_listings_financials_nonnegative.name: business_listings_financials_nonnegative
business_listings_financials_nonnegative.value: ("business_listings"."asking_price" IS NULL OR "business_listings"."asking_price" >= 0) AND ("business_listings"."annual_revenue" IS NULL OR "business_listings"."annual_revenue" >= 0) AND ("business_listings"."ebitda" IS NULL OR "business_listings"."ebitda" >= 0)
